exposure: Age: Adolescents (≤19 years) vs. young adults (>19 years)
Age groups: Adolescents and young adults
cohort: Pregnant females aged 25 years or below, presenting for routine obstetrical care at a New York City community hospital
finding: Urinary incontinence was prevalent in 52% of pregnant females aged 25 years or below, with no significant differences between adolescents and young adults.
